bo-1ybL.title: Landscape: huge high plain, tufted grass
bo-1ybL.summary: The Altiplano is a huge highland plateau of grassland, from green to arid, with tufts of grass. The road is mostly flat, though hills and mountains surround it.

bo-3bLQ.title: City: hilly with round tree-covered hills
bo-3bLQ.summary: Sucre is very hilly with lots of elevation change in its streets, and you often see round hills covered in trees.

bo-4FCc.title: People: bowler hats, shawls, wide pleated skirts
bo-4FCc.summary: Many women wear traditional dress: bowler hats, colourful shawls and big pleated skirts (pollera). Parts of Peru near the border are similar.

bo-5Eqs.title: Houses: big red bricks, unfinished look
bo-5Eqs.summary: Many buildings are made of large red bricks and look unfinished. Parts of Peru look the same.

bo-8Fju.title: Gates: gradient paint, green or red to yellow
bo-8Fju.summary: Gates and doors in El Alto are sometimes painted in a gradient, dark to light green or red to yellow.

bo-8f7Q.title: City: flat, tropical big city
bo-8f7Q.summary: Santa Cruz is the only large city in a tropical flat landscape. Smaller nearby towns look almost identical, some with side-road coverage.

bo-8kIo.title: Guardrail: yellow stripes on the outside
bo-8kIo.summary: Guardrails sometimes have yellow and black markings, always with yellow on the outside. Peru has the opposite, with black on the outside.

differs.how: black stripes are on the outside

bo-9yGO.title: City: hilly but arid, bare hilltops
bo-9yGO.summary: Potosí is hilly like Sucre, but much drier, with few or no trees on the hills.

bo-Cx1O.title: City: flat valley, mountain wall to the north
bo-Cx1O.summary: Cochabamba sits in a big flat valley with a tall wall of mountains to the north. This is the best way to tell it from other cities.

bo-D81j.title: Route marker: black top 'Km', white distance
bo-D81j.summary: Black and white km markers: black top with 'Km', white bottom with the distance, and no road number. Argentine markers look similar from afar but have a road number.

differs.how: Argentine km markers show a road number

bo-DNvg.title: Google car: square smudge on front left
bo-DNvg.summary: A square smudge sits on the front left of the camera along a long stretch of Ruta 4, from the high plain east through Cochabamba to the flat Amazon area.

bo-EDdZ.title: City: driest landscape, dry hill to the west
bo-EDdZ.summary: Oruro is in by far the driest landscape, flat and arid, usually with a large dry hill to the west. Potosí is also arid but much hillier.

bo-EPdA.title: Landscape: huge lake on the border, very green
bo-EPdA.summary: Lake Titicaca on the Peru border is the main body of water, seen from two roads (Ruta 1 with the lake to the north, Ruta 2 mostly south or west). The surroundings are greener than the west.

differs.how: the lake is shared, so use plates and car

bo-ERwi.title: Road: big divided highway on the plateau
bo-ERwi.summary: Ruta 1 and 4 between La Paz and Oruro is a big divided highway across the high plain. It is the only large divided highway in the country.

bo-EaWE.title: Landscape: reddish rocks and soil
bo-EaWE.summary: Last resort for a 50-50: rocks and soil often have a reddish tint, more than the other Andean countries. Use with caution.

bo-FZk4.title: Road: extremely light, almost white concrete
bo-FZk4.summary: Ruta 6 between Tarabuco and Zudáñez has extremely light-coloured, almost white concrete, unique to this road.

bo-IE29.title: Road: unpaved bendy road in jungle mountains
bo-IE29.summary: The N Yungas 'Death Road' is a small, winding dirt road high in the mountains with tropical plants. The south is very foggy and looks dangerous, with cyclists sometimes. The north is less foggy but still the only dirt road through jungle hills.

bo-IcXQ.title: Sign: bulky white square signposts
bo-IcXQ.summary: Bulky white square signposts. Peru uses black and white striped 'zebra' posts.

differs.how: black and white striped zebra signposts

bo-ImLA.title: Coverage: unpaved roads with pink soil
bo-ImLA.summary: In the tropical east, unpaved road coverage is only around Santa Cruz, with the typical pink soil.

bo-JmzU.title: Pavement: grey bricks with wavy edges
bo-JmzU.summary: Rectangular grey paving bricks with slightly wavy edges are very common in El Alto.

bo-JsPk.title: Road: curvy and hilly, grey skies
bo-JsPk.summary: Southeast of Challapata the road is more curvy and hilly, with much worse weather and grey skies.

bo-K0y8.title: City: flat dusty plateau, endless red bricks
bo-K0y8.summary: El Alto is on a flat highland plateau, drier and dustier than La Paz, with a grid of streets and endless unfinished red-brick buildings. Some areas look rundown.

bo-KhV3.title: Landscape: lush grass in the north of the plateau
bo-KhV3.summary: The northern half of the high plain, near the twin cities, has lusher grass. Seasons can cause exceptions.

bo-LUMw.title: Road: worn grainy asphalt in semi-arid grass
bo-LUMw.summary: Ruta 4 southwest of Patacamaya runs through semi-arid grassland. Between Patacamaya and Callapa the asphalt is often worn and grainy.

bo-N4Rl.title: Landscape: eroded yellow-beige rock pillars
bo-N4Rl.summary: Eroded pillar-like rocks of yellow-beige sandstone on hillsides, in many parts of La Paz. Unique among the big cities.

bo-Q7C9.title: Coverage: sunset light, concrete road, dry hills
bo-Q7C9.summary: Ruta 5 around Chaco, north of Sucre, was filmed at sunset. Mostly concrete road winding through semi-arid hills.

bo-RDmK.title: City: twin cities that look different
bo-RDmK.summary: La Paz and El Alto form one big urban area but look very different from each other.

bo-RTyP.title: Houses: colourful futuristic Neo-Andean facades
bo-RTyP.summary: Colourful buildings with elaborate, futuristic-looking fronts (Neo-Andean). Almost only in El Alto.

bo-TP1D.title: Coverage: limited, six main cities
bo-TP1D.summary: Very limited coverage in the central and central-west only, mostly around six big cities that have side-street coverage. Elsewhere only main roads, and many of those have long unpaved parts.

bo-UDKX.title: Road: dirt road that looks like Peru
bo-UDKX.summary: Near Morochata on Ruta 25 a small piece of coverage looks extremely like Peru: a dirt road through mountains, green with fields and eucalyptus in the west, arid and high in the east.

differs.how: almost identical, so memorise this road

bo-VfJf.title: Landscape: arid, snow on hilltops, overcast
bo-VfJf.summary: Ruta 1 between Machacamarca and Guindal is arid with patches of snow on the hilltops and sometimes next to the road, under cloudy to fully overcast, gloomy skies.

bo-WzWu.title: City: very hilly, green hillsides
bo-WzWu.summary: La Paz is very hilly, in winding valleys with green hillsides, unlike drier hills in other cities.

bo-Z8Ei.title: Landscape: arid in the south of the plateau
bo-Z8Ei.summary: The southern half, around Oruro and roads towards Chile, looks more arid. One side of a divided highway looks green due to a different season.

differs.how: roads toward Chile look very arid, so use other clues

bo-ZO0c.title: Road: cobblestones around one valley city
bo-ZO0c.summary: Cobblestone roads are mainly in and southeast of Cochabamba, also around Sucre, very rarely in La Paz.

bo-a0MD.title: Landscape: very green hills, sunny, low plants
bo-a0MD.summary: Around the town of Mataral: very green hills under sunny skies with a few clouds. The plants are green but low and not dense. Limited to Ruta 7 (Comarapa to Mairana) and Ruta 22.

bo-aQXK.title: Road: asphalt and concrete slabs
bo-aQXK.summary: Mostly normal asphalt, but concrete slab roads are also fairly common.

bo-blRX.title: Landscape: lone snow-capped volcano
bo-blRX.summary: Nevado Sajama is a single snow-capped volcano unlike any other mountain here, visible on the far southwest part of Ruta 4 (south of Callapa), though hills often hide it. The only other place to see it is the park coverage with its unique car.

bo-caq9.title: Google car: black roof rack with metal bars
bo-caq9.summary: A national park was covered by a unique car with a black roof rack with several metal bars. Unpaved road, fluffy bushes, always with the snow volcano in view, and a small village with adobe walls and thatched roofs.

bo-dcL2.title: Graffiti: MAS and Evo, black, white and blue
bo-dcL2.summary: The ruling party at the time was MAS, so graffiti often says MAS and Evo (the president). Things are also painted in the party colours of black, white and a big blue field.

bo-eNja.title: Pole: round concrete with pinholes, or wooden
bo-eNja.summary: Round concrete poles with small pinholes near the top, or wooden poles. Poles are very inconsistent here. Argentine-style concrete poles appear rarely.

differs.how: Argentine-style concrete poles are rare here

bo-fO7D.title: Landscape: tall mountains of the Andes
bo-fO7D.summary: Tall mountains around you mean the Andes, running northwest to southeast between the high plain and the rainforest. The plain has a few smaller or lone mountains too.

bo-gP54.title: Houses: very tall buildings downtown
bo-gP54.summary: Downtown La Paz is the only place with very tall buildings (10+ floors).

bo-hZLQ.title: Landscape: giant bare pyramid mountain
bo-hZLQ.summary: Cerro Rico is a huge pyramid-shaped mountain stripped bare by silver mining, visible in many parts of Potosí.

bo-jgzQ.title: Google car: white car, no antenna, Gen 3
bo-jgzQ.summary: Only the older Gen 3 camera, on a plain white car with no antenna. Peru and Chile also have white cars with no antenna.

bo-k1TC.title: Flag: square rainbow patchwork
bo-k1TC.summary: A second official flag, the Wiphala, is a square patchwork of seven diagonally arranged colours, sometimes on government buildings and project signs.

bo-ltvb.title: Ads: blue Tigo telecom logo
bo-ltvb.summary: City ads for Tigo, with a blue logo. Tigo does not operate in Peru, so this helps with urban Peru vs this country 50-50s. It exists in several other Latin American countries.

bo-mHkr.title: Plants: big cacti and yellow-flowered trees
bo-mHkr.summary: In that area you often see large cacti among bushes and trees with yellow flowers.

bo-qTVY.title: Pole: very curvy wooden poles
bo-qTVY.summary: Many wooden poles, mostly in the east, are visibly crooked, as if made from local tree trunks. Extremely curvy poles are a strong clue.

bo-qrcc.title: Plate: short white, blue text
bo-qrcc.summary: Short white plates with blue letters. The blue is hard to see through the blur, so plates can look plain white. Peru has white or yellow plates.

differs.how: Peruvian plates are white or yellow

bo-qsZg.title: Landscape: extreme desert and salt flat
bo-qsZg.summary: An isolated stretch near Ruta 12 by the Chile border where the car drove through extremely arid desert, over a salt flat, then on dirt with cone-shaped volcanic hills. It blends into the salt flat on the map. Almost no plants.

differs.how: near the Chilean border, so check the car and plates

bo-rTJh.title: Road: cobblestones with neat lines
bo-rTJh.summary: Lots of cobblestone roads, often with neat straight lines of stones between the messier cobbles.

bo-sBx6.title: Road: straight NNW, flat, some sky visible
bo-sBx6.summary: North of Challapata the road runs NNW, straight over flat land with hills on one or both sides. Weather is a bit better, with some sky visible, especially looking south.

bo-sz3k.title: Road: east-west through flat green land
bo-sz3k.summary: The eastern part of Ruta 4 east of Santa Cruz runs east-west through flat green land with some low hills, in both asphalt and concrete sections.

bo-tbQH.title: Houses: white walls, orange tiles, colonial
bo-tbQH.summary: Sucre has a well-preserved old centre with colonial buildings, white walls and orange tiled roofs.

bo-wFBZ.title: Road lines: centre yellow, white or mixed, edge white
bo-wFBZ.summary: Centre lines can be all yellow, yellow and white, or all white. Edge lines are always white. Chile never mixes yellow and white; Peru has roads with edge lines only, which are very rare here.

differs.how: never mixes yellow and white centre lines

bo-xCqp.title: Landscape: huge mountains in clouds, dark grey rock
bo-xCqp.summary: The section of Ruta 3 near Pongo has enormous mountains, often in low clouds, with dark grey rocks lightly covered in greenish grass.

bo-xLWH.title: Landscape: green tropical flat land, pink soil
bo-xLWH.summary: East of the Andes is very green and tropical, mostly flat farmland, with some big hills near the Andes. Soil is pinkish.

bo-ykan.title: Google car: neon-coloured glitch
bo-ykan.summary: On Ruta 7 between Mairana and Santa Cruz a camera bug gives a neon-like discolouration, usually to the north. It also rarely appears near Santa Cruz, where it is often milder.

bo-zvmK.title: Road: paved through green grass, white numbers
bo-zvmK.summary: Ruta 1 west of El Alto is a paved road through green grassland, mostly flat with hills nearby, and white painted numbers on the road. Near the end you may see the lake to the north. Looks like Ruta 2 northwest; use road angles.

differs.how: similar roads, use car and plates
